entries.title: Proverbs 12:6
segments:
CHAP. XII. 
 
  V. 6. Lie in wait-Are designed to entrap others, and to destroy them. Deliver them-From those that lie in wait for them.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:7
segments: V. 7. Are not-Both they and their families suddenly perish.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:9
segments: V. 9. Despised-That lives in a mean condition.  Honoureth-That glories in his high birth or gay attire.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:10
segments: V. 10. Regardeth-He will not destroy it either by labour beyond its strength, or by denying it necessary food or rest.  Cruel-There is cruelty mixed even with their most merciful actions.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:11
segments: V. 11. Tilleth-That employs his time in an honest calling. Vain persons-In an idle course of living.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:12
segments: V. 12. Desireth-He approves those arts, which wicked men use like nets to ensnare other men.  The root-That piety, which is the root of his actions, yields him sufficient fruit both for his own need, and to do good to others.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:14
segments: V. 14. Mouth-By his pious and profitable discourses.  Hands-Of his actions.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:15
segments: V. 15. Hearkeneth-That distrusts his own judgments, and seeks counsel from others.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:16
segments: V. 16. Covereth-The shame, or injury done to him, which he conceals and bears with patience.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:17
segments: V. 17. Deceit-He who uses himself to lying in his common talk, will use falsehood and deceit in judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:18
segments: V. 18. Health-Tends to the comfort and benefit of others.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:19
segments: V. 19. A moment-Liars, though they may make a fair shew for a season, yet are quickly convicted.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:20
segments: V. 20. Deceit-They whose hearts devise mischief shall be deceived in their hopes, and bring trouble upon themselves: but they who by good counsels labour to promote peace, shall reap the comfort of it themselves.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:23
segments: V. 23. Concealeth-He does not unseasonably utter what he knows. Foolishness-Betrays his ignorance and folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:25
segments: V. 25. A good word-A compassionate or encouraging word.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:26
segments: V. 26. Neighbour-Than any other men.  Seduceth-Heb. maketh them to err, to lose that excellency or happiness which they had promised themselves.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:27
segments: V. 27. Resteth not-Does not enjoy the fruit of his labours. Precious-Yields him comfort and blessing with it.
